title: Juicy Indian Egg Curry
description: A delicious and comforting Indian-inspired egg curry that's perfect for a solo dinner. Made with blanched eggs and a blend of aromatic spices, this dish is not only juicy but also diabetic-friendly.
instructions: Heat butter or oil in a pan over medium heat. Add cumin powder and let it sizzle for a few seconds.
Add chopped onion and sauté until translucent. Then add minced garlic and grated ginger and sauté for another minute.
Add chopped green chilies, tomato puree, garam masala, cumin powder, turmeric powder, and coriander powder. Stir well to combine.
Add blanched eggs to the pan and stir well to coat with the spice mixture.
Add salt to taste and 1 cup of water to the pan. Stir well to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and let the curry simmer for 5-7 minutes or until the eggs are cooked through.
Garnish with chopped coriander leaves, if desired.
Serve hot over rice or with roti/naan.
